description: This PHP source file defines classes for compiling Smarty template tags related to {foreach}, {foreachelse}, and {/foreach}. It contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Foreach class, which handles compiling the foreach loop in Smarty templates, as well as associated classes for handling else and closing tags.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Foreach
classes.description: Handles the compilation of {foreach} loop tags in Smarty templates, managing attributes, loop variables, and generating the appropriate PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Foreachelse
classes.description: Handles the compilation of {foreachelse} tags, managing the alternative branch of the foreach loop.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Foreachclose
classes.description: Handles the closure of {/foreach} tags, restoring loop variables and finalizing the compiled loop code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method for compiling the {foreach} tag into PHP code, handling attribute validation and code generation.

methods.name: compileRestore
methods.description: Generates code to restore previous template variables after loop completion.
